data.one_liner: Stream PCM audio data from the microphone on Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: Provides a singleton audio streamer that exposes a stream of Pulse-code modulation (PCM) audio data buffers. Allows customization of the sampling rate.
use_when: You need real-time PCM audio streaming from the microphone for processing or analysis
You are building an audio visualization tool or custom recording app
avoid_when: You only need simple background music or sound effect playback
Your target iOS deployment target is below 16.0 or Android minSdk is below 24
strengths: Provides raw PCM audio streams directly
weaknesses: High minimum SDK requirements (iOS 16.0+, Android minSdk 24)
data.setup_notes: Requires RECORD_AUDIO permission on Android and NSMicrophoneUsageDescription plus background audio modes on iOS.

alternatives.name: record
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want to record audio to a file rather than stream raw PCM buffers.

alternatives.name: audioplayers
alternatives.why_pick_it: If your primary goal is playing audio files or streams rather than recording from the mic.

alternatives.name: just_audio
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need advanced audio playback capabilities.
